title: Bonus: escalating bank scam
summary: A caller escalates from an OTP request to remote access and a 'safe account' transfer. Shows High -> Critical escalation.
voice_note: Written as a human caller. No audio is bundled.

expected.note: A High ping at the OTP request, a Critical ping when remote access is requested, and a final Critical ping when the caller asks to move money. Repeats in between stay silent.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: Good afternoon, I'm calling from the bank's security department.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: We have detected suspicious activity on your account.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: Please tell me the OTP that was just sent to your mobile so I can block the transaction.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: Then please install AnyDesk now so I can reverse the transaction for you.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: Do not call the bank, this is not a normal procedure.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: Now move your savings to the safe account I will give you.
